Assignment: Module 12 (Scholarly Commentary & Annotation)

Overview: In this milestone, you will author scholarly commentary notes for a 5-sentence passage from your primary witness text spanning three distinct categories (philological, historical, intertextual). You will encode them using stand-off TEI markup, export a W3C JSON-LD annotation with a TextQuoteSelector, and conduct a Three-Way Comparative Audit (Manual vs Deterministic vs AI) recorded in COMMENTARY.md.

Due Date: Friday, December 4, by 11:00 PM.
